summary.result: The spatial results by applying regression equations showed that the severe and moderate drought conditions of July and September in 1994, June in 1995, and May in 2001 were well expressed by the watershed unit.
summary.background: The method was applied to Geum river basin and the results were represented as spatially distributed information.
summary.method: Using the results, multiple regression analyses with precipitation and reservoir storage as variables were conducted and the equations were applied to other watersheds.
